bandReport.notes: All transcribed verbatim with the booklet's own errors kept. No two-answer instruction anywhere in Q1-25. Printed errors: Q1-2 report 'enthusiam' (enthusiasm), 'Highschool', the fragment 'with a special assembly. Where teachers shared stories...', and the heading dated '15 November' while the text says November 14; Q3 'what does the underlined word mean ?' lowercase 'what' (the underline in print runs under the quotation marks too: 'bazar'); Q4 'A student who has good Nature respect to' (verb missing) and 'choose correct alternative'; Q9 option (2) 'Yatch' (yacht); Q12 'Predication' (prediction); Q14 option (3) 'hyperbol' and 'a complete darkness'; Q17 'had delivered a gift' with no full stop before 'Is it yours ?', 'from shop', 'Secretly' capitalised; Q19 'Jack of all and' (the word 'trades' is missing in print); Q24 no final full stop; Q25 'Choose the correct option' no full stop. Q12-13 news: 'Sagarole, Monday (24th):' is printed bold italic (kept plain) and 'ventured' carries an asterisk with no footnote on the page (kept as a superscript *). Q4 and Q10 are printed as word-web diagrams whose every word is text: Q4's web is a box with the blank and four arrows to the options (transcribed as the stem sentence + options); Q10's web is a centre box '?' with arrows to four boxes, transcribed in the stem as a bracketed line. Neither needs a picture, so no FIGURE flag. Q8's notice is unique to Q8, so it sits in the stem. The line 'Read the given news and choose the options.' printed between the Q12-13 box and Q12 is kept at the start of both stems. Catalog gaps: Q10 (word web / mind map completion) has no chapter, filed under Vocabulary and Word Usage; Q23 (choosing a Wh-question word for an underlined answer) has no chapter, filed under Sentence Transformation; suggested chapter 'Framing Questions (Wh-words)'.

TWELVE FISHERMEN MISSING
Sagarole, Monday (24\(^{\text{th}}\)): Twelve fishermen are said to be missing from the coast of Pankot since Monday. Heavy rains and storms were predicted for the whole of last week. Repeated warnings were given on radio, TV and newspapers. However, these fishermen had ventured\(^{*}\) into the sea for fishing early Friday morning. Nothing has been learnt about the four boats or the twelve fishermen since then. Coastguards in the area have been alerted and a search has been undertaken.
